question.text: Tax efficiency as an investment objective aims at:

answer.text: Optimising POST-tax returns using legal tax-efficient instruments

explanation.text: The Logic: Source p.126 frames tax efficiency as investing in tax-saving instruments to optimise post-tax returns, while pp.145-146 distinguish pre-tax and post-tax return. Together they support tax efficiency as the lawful optimisation of post-tax returns through tax-saving instruments. The Trap: Evasion is illegal; chasing deductions or penalty reduction misses the post-tax-return objective on p.126. Note: Compare investment options on a post-tax basis as set out on pp.145-146.
